keyPoints.en: The British expanded into Penang (1786), Singapore (1819) and Melaka (1824).
keyPoints.bm: British meluaskan kuasa ke Pulau Pinang (1786), Singapura (1819) dan Melaka (1824).

keyPoints.en: Penang: Francis Light occupied it after Sultan Abdullah of Kedah asked for protection against Siam.
keyPoints.bm: Pulau Pinang: Francis Light mendudukinya selepas Sultan Abdullah Kedah meminta perlindungan daripada Siam.

keyPoints.en: Singapore: Stamford Raffles recognised Tengku Hussein as Sultan of Johor and signed a treaty (1819).
keyPoints.bm: Singapura: Stamford Raffles mengiktiraf Tengku Hussein sebagai Sultan Johor dan menandatangani perjanjian (1819).

keyPoints.en: Melaka: received from the Dutch under the London Treaty (1824).
keyPoints.bm: Melaka: diterima daripada Belanda melalui Perjanjian London (1824).

meaning.en: EIC trader who occupied Penang on 11 August 1786.
meaning.bm: Pedagang SHTI yang menduduki Pulau Pinang pada 11 Ogos 1786.

meaning.en: EIC officer who founded British Singapore in 1819.
meaning.bm: Pegawai SHTI yang mengasaskan Singapura British pada 1819.

meaning.en: A port with little or no tax — helped Penang and Singapore grow.
meaning.bm: Pelabuhan dengan cukai yang sedikit atau tiada — membantu Pulau Pinang dan Singapura berkembang.

points.en: A naval base and port on the India–China trade route; a place to collect goods from the region.
points.bm: Pangkalan tentera laut dan pelabuhan di laluan perdagangan India–China; tempat mengumpul barang dari rantau ini.

points.en: 1786: Light occupied Penang, but the EIC refused to give Kedah military protection.
points.bm: 1786: Light menduduki Pulau Pinang, tetapi SHTI enggan memberi perlindungan tentera kepada Kedah.

points.en: 1791: Kedah tried to take Penang back but failed.
points.bm: 1791: Kedah cuba merampas semula Pulau Pinang tetapi gagal.

points.en: 1791 treaty: the EIC paid Kedah 6,000 Spanish dollars a year.
points.bm: Perjanjian 1791: SHTI membayar Kedah 6,000 dolar Sepanyol setahun.

points.en: 1800 treaty: Seberang Perai was added and the payment rose to 10,000 dollars a year.
points.bm: Perjanjian 1800: Seberang Perai ditambah dan bayaran dinaikkan kepada 10,000 dolar setahun.

points.en: Importance: strategic position, a deep harbour, and a way to check Dutch power.
points.bm: Kepentingan: kedudukan strategik, pelabuhan yang dalam, dan cara mengimbangi kuasa Belanda.

points.en: 1819: Raffles landed and signed a treaty with Tengku Hussein and Temenggung Abdul Rahman.
points.bm: 1819: Raffles mendarat dan menandatangani perjanjian dengan Tengku Hussein dan Temenggung Abdul Rahman.

points.en: 1824: a new treaty (by John Crawfurd) handed Singapore fully to the British.
points.bm: 1824: perjanjian baharu (oleh John Crawfurd) menyerahkan Singapura sepenuhnya kepada British.

points.en: British–Dutch cooperation in Europe: the Dutch let the British hold Melaka during the Napoleonic Wars; it became British permanently in 1824.
points.bm: Pakatan British–Belanda di Eropah: Belanda membenarkan British memegang Melaka semasa Perang Napoleon; Melaka menjadi milik British secara kekal pada 1824.

event.en: Kedah–EIC treaty after Kedah fails to retake Penang.
event.bm: Perjanjian Kedah–SHTI selepas Kedah gagal merampas semula Pulau Pinang.

event.en: Singapore ceded fully; Melaka British under the London Treaty.
event.bm: Singapura diserahkan sepenuhnya; Melaka milik British melalui Perjanjian London.

question.en: Why did the Sultan of Kedah allow Francis Light to occupy Penang?
question.bm: Mengapakah Sultan Kedah membenarkan Francis Light menduduki Pulau Pinang?

answer.en: He hoped the British would protect Kedah from attacks by Siam (and Burma). The British did not keep this promise.
answer.bm: Baginda berharap British akan melindungi Kedah daripada serangan Siam (dan Burma). British tidak menunaikan janji ini.

keyPoints.en: The London Treaty (Anglo-Dutch Treaty) was signed on 17 March 1824.
keyPoints.bm: Perjanjian London (Perjanjian Inggeris-Belanda) ditandatangani pada 17 Mac 1824.

keyPoints.en: Britain got Melaka and the area north of the Singapore Strait; the Dutch got Bencoolen and the area south.
keyPoints.bm: British mendapat Melaka dan kawasan utara Selat Singapura; Belanda mendapat Bangkahulu dan kawasan selatan.

keyPoints.en: Effects: the Malay world was split into two Western spheres, the Johor-Riau empire was broken up, and the Strait of Melaka came under British control.
keyPoints.bm: Kesan: Alam Melayu dibahagi kepada dua lingkungan pengaruh Barat, Empayar Johor-Riau berpecah, dan Selat Melaka di bawah penguasaan British.

meaning.en: An area where one power has control or special rights.
meaning.bm: Kawasan tempat sesebuah kuasa mempunyai kawalan atau hak istimewa.

meaning.en: British base in Sumatra exchanged with the Dutch for Melaka.
meaning.bm: Pangkalan British di Sumatera yang ditukar dengan Melaka milik Belanda.

heading.bm: a. Pembahagian kepada dua lingkungan pengaruh

points.en: Britain: the Malay Peninsula and Singapore. The Dutch: Sumatra, Java and the islands south of Singapore.
points.bm: British: Semenanjung Tanah Melayu dan Singapura. Belanda: Sumatera, Jawa dan pulau di selatan Singapura.

points.en: The rulers of the Malay world were never consulted.
points.bm: Raja-raja di Alam Melayu tidak pernah dirunding.

heading.en: b. Break-up of the Johor-Riau empire

points.en: Johor and Singapore fell under British influence; Riau-Lingga under the Dutch.
points.bm: Johor dan Singapura di bawah pengaruh British; Riau-Lingga di bawah Belanda.

heading.en: c. Strait of Melaka under British control
heading.bm: c. Selat Melaka di bawah penguasaan British

points.en: With Penang, Melaka and Singapore, Britain controlled the strait's trade — and the line later became the basis of the Malaysia–Indonesia border.
points.bm: Dengan Pulau Pinang, Melaka dan Singapura, British menguasai perdagangan selat — dan garis ini kemudian menjadi asas sempadan Malaysia–Indonesia.

question.en: Why is the London Treaty 1824 still important today?
question.bm: Mengapakah Perjanjian London 1824 masih penting hari ini?

answer.en: Its dividing line became the basis of the boundary between Malaysia and Indonesia.
answer.bm: Garis pembahagiannya menjadi asas sempadan antara Malaysia dengan Indonesia.

keyPoints.en: In 1826 the British joined Penang, Melaka and Singapore into the Straits Settlements (Negeri-negeri Selat).
keyPoints.bm: Pada 1826 British menggabungkan Pulau Pinang, Melaka dan Singapura menjadi Negeri-negeri Selat.

keyPoints.en: The aim was easier, cheaper and more efficient administration.
keyPoints.bm: Tujuannya ialah pentadbiran yang lebih mudah, jimat dan cekap.

keyPoints.en: The first capital was Penang; it moved to Singapore in 1832.
keyPoints.bm: Ibu negeri pertama ialah Pulau Pinang; ia berpindah ke Singapura pada 1832.

meaning.en: British colony of Penang, Melaka and Singapore, formed in 1826.
meaning.bm: Tanah jajahan British yang terdiri daripada Pulau Pinang, Melaka dan Singapura, dibentuk pada 1826.

meaning.en: British officials governed the colony themselves.
meaning.bm: Pegawai British memerintah tanah jajahan itu sendiri.

points.en: Before: each settlement was run separately, which was costly.
points.bm: Sebelum: setiap negeri ditadbir secara berasingan, yang memakan kos.

points.en: 1826: one Governor for all three, with a Resident Councillor in each.
points.bm: 1826: seorang Gabenor bagi ketiga-tiganya, dengan seorang Residen Kaunselor di setiap negeri.

points.en: Straits merchants traded with and invested in the Malay states, especially in tin.
points.bm: Pedagang Negeri-negeri Selat berdagang dan melabur di Negeri-negeri Melayu, terutamanya dalam bijih timah.

points.en: When unrest hit their investments, they pressed Britain to intervene — leading to the Pangkor Treaty (1874).
points.bm: Apabila kekacauan menjejaskan pelaburan mereka, mereka mendesak British campur tangan — membawa kepada Perjanjian Pangkor (1874).

question.en: Why did the British form the Straits Settlements?

answer.en: To run the three settlements as one unit — cheaper, easier and more efficient — and to strengthen British trade in the Strait of Melaka.
answer.bm: Untuk mentadbir ketiga-tiga negeri sebagai satu unit — lebih jimat, mudah dan cekap — serta mengukuhkan perdagangan British di Selat Melaka.

keyPoints.en: 1826–1867: the Straits Settlements were ruled from British India — by the East India Company (1826–1857), then the India Office (1858–1867).
keyPoints.bm: 1826–1867: Negeri-negeri Selat diperintah dari India British — oleh SHTI (1826–1857), kemudian Pejabat India (1858–1867).

keyPoints.en: 1867–1946: they became a Crown Colony under the Colonial Office in London.
keyPoints.bm: 1867–1946: menjadi Tanah Jajahan Mahkota di bawah Pejabat Tanah Jajahan di London.

keyPoints.en: Straits merchants were unhappy with rule from India, which led to the transfer.
keyPoints.bm: Pedagang Negeri-negeri Selat tidak berpuas hati dengan pemerintahan dari India, lalu membawa kepada pemindahan.

meaning.en: Head of the Straits Settlements administration.
Officer in charge of each settlement.
Colony ruled directly by the British government from London (from 1 April 1867).
meaning.bm: Tanah jajahan yang diperintah terus oleh kerajaan British dari London (mulai 1 April 1867).

heading.en: a. Under the East India Company (1826–1857)

points.en: Governed through the EIC's government in India; a Governor with Resident Councillors.
points.bm: Ditadbir melalui kerajaan SHTI di India; seorang Gabenor dengan Residen Kaunselor.

points.en: After the Indian Mutiny (1857) the EIC lost its power and India was ruled by the British government.
points.bm: Selepas Pemberontakan India (1857) SHTI hilang kuasa dan India diperintah oleh kerajaan British.

points.en: Reasons for the transfer: India ignored local needs; laws were made in India; the Indian rupee was imposed; convicts were sent to the Straits; piracy was not dealt with.
points.bm: Sebab pemindahan: India mengabaikan keperluan tempatan; undang-undang dibuat di India; rupee India dipaksakan; banduan dihantar ke Negeri-negeri Selat; masalah lanun tidak ditangani.

points.en: The Governor now had Executive and Legislative Councils to help him.
points.bm: Gabenor kini dibantu Majlis Mesyuarat Kerja dan Majlis Perundangan.

event.en: Straits Settlements formed under the EIC.
event.bm: Negeri-negeri Selat dibentuk di bawah SHTI.

question.en: Why did Straits merchants want rule transferred from India to London?
question.bm: Mengapakah pedagang Negeri-negeri Selat mahukan pemerintahan dipindahkan dari India ke London?

answer.en: India neglected the settlements — making laws without local knowledge, imposing the rupee, sending convicts and failing to stop piracy — which hurt trade.
answer.bm: India mengabaikan Negeri-negeri Selat — membuat undang-undang tanpa memahami keadaan tempatan, memaksakan rupee, menghantar banduan dan gagal membanteras lanun — lalu menjejaskan perdagangan.
